notes.title: New update - Patch #1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/ce1d84241e2ef4f3574e8fc3ed119e2bfdd24b5f.jpg

The most important stage of the World Cup is coming up!

The final phase, with grand finale in Moscow on June 15th has already begun. Unfortunately, the Polish national team had to say goodbye to the tournament, but our support for the team will last nevertheless.

Specifically for the knock-out stage we have prepared an update giving you the opportunity to play as players competing in the World Cup, who scored wonderful goals. 

Additionally, we have introduced smaller adjustments, which improved the looks and performance of the game.

New version of Turbo Soccer VR contains:

5 replays from the first round of the World Cup:

Russia vs. Saudi Arabia - 12th minute of the game
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/bdcaf5a4c20aa5e19cb22cf637599545dec72780.jpg

Portugal vs. Spain - 88th minute of the game
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/f6c5cbe6b9e6ee59b6846b77074ba776fa159411.jpg

Peru vs. Denmark - 59th minute of the game
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/8a6993873587fb0c1d6354fb6f64eb9d946c64fa.jpg

Brazil vs. Switzerland - 20th minute of the game
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/ee276b9259aa4b22af2a22758e0118f27f264482.jpg

Germany vs. Mexico - 30th minute of the game
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/c518aee8b002be541e368a74fa950f7aa4a5f6c5.jpg

Additionally:

new replay menu with a notification tab informing about the match from which the replay has been taken;
improved gameplay;
optimized performance.


Thank you for the warm welcome you have given to Turbo Soccer VR. Next week we will be releasing a new update introducing replays taken from the next matches from the World Cup in Russia.

notes.title: Turbo Soccer, a mobile game with Kamil Grosicki
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/34ded4698b2dfc68869b22a2b64e8a303deb350c.jpg

Turbo Soccer today on all mobile devices with Android and iOS operating system. Kamil Grosicki is the face and the main character of the game. Player can control his moves by dodging sliding tackles from the defenders of the opposing team and shooting on goal.

 Download Turbo Soccer

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/01ac2b27eeaf8d349547651920004987148c1cd6.png

Players will have multiple game modes to choose from, but scoring goals and progressing to next levels of the game will depend on their skills and reflexes.

Turbo Soccer is already available on Google Play and App Store.

Key features:

Like on a real pitch - Camera located behind player’s back makes you feel like on a green football field
Goal after goal - Dynamic action lets you play ball fast
Be like Kamil - Speed up, dribble past defender and shot on goal!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/6d4f1d0095203a685b44d8771bc5cb2560b6bee5.png

Kamil Grosicki
Kamil Grosicki is one of the top players of the Polish national football team and English Championship club - Hull City A.F.C. Earlier he has played in teams such as Turkish Sivasspor or French Stade Rennais. Recently he has joined the team of Turbo Soccer VR, a new game utilizing virtual reality, produced by Dodo4Story Games.
